source_refs.note: Topic 12.11.2, printed page 283. The printed gypsum formula CaSO4.5H2O is noted (dihydrate).

blocks.text: Sulfur is an essential nutrient for plant growth. When soils become depleted in sulfate, sulfur is restored by applying sulfur-containing N/P fertilisers or sulfur-coated fertilisers such as sulfur-coated urea; soil components and microbes convert elemental sulfur into soluble forms for plants. Gypsum (CaSO4.2H2O) is also used as a fertiliser.
